description: This PHP class 'EmailQueueDao' provides data access methods for managing email queue entries in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve, save, delete, and list pending email IDs, interacting with the 'Mail' entity.

classes.name: EmailQueueDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for email queue entries, providing methods to retrieve, save, delete, and list email IDs in the queue.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a Mail entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmail
methods.description: Saves a Mail entity to the database.

methods.name: removeFromQueue
methods.description: Removes multiple Mail entities from the queue based on their IDs.

methods.name: getAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Retrieves the IDs of all pending Mail entities.
